# Explain the current direction

Explain the current direction again with enough context for the user to follow it.
Use ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
Use the glossary's domain terms.
Read `CONTEXT.md`, or `GLOSSARY.md` where the repo already uses that name.
If several glossaries exist, follow `CONTEXT-MAP.md` to the relevant one.
